question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable-runtime schema and read-only Gateway/CLI inspection contract on the 2026.7.1 release line, and if so, should it land only after the preceding durable stack is accepted and upgrade-proven?
rationale: The patch is technically viable, but automation cannot decide whether this broad persisted core-runtime and public protocol contract is the intended product architecture or which predecessor state must be supported on the release branch.

options.title: Sponsor ordered durable stack
options.body: Accept the architecture direction, retarget or sequence this PR after the approved predecessor, and require exact predecessor-upgrade plus session/delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Land as one combined beta stack
options.body: Explicitly approve the entire accumulated PR1–PR4 contract as one release-branch landing and own the resulting schema and SDK compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer durable core
options.body: Pause or close this PR until the core durable-runtime direction has a maintainer-sponsored design and release plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor ordered durable stack
recommendation.body: Accept the architecture direction, retarget or sequence this PR after the approved predecessor, and require exact predecessor-upgrade plus session/delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to repository-level Gateway, session, orchestration, and core-scope decisions.
